job: Extend expert offload past system RAM into an application-managed disk cache and promote it from experimental flag to supported path.
outcome: Release-note-visible disk-streaming expert offload with published guidance for 500B-plus models under 32GB of RAM and no discrete GPU.
motivation: Leaning on the operating system page cache no longer holds as published parameter counts outrun the memory enthusiasts actually own.

motivation: Demonstrating a working floor beats arguing for one; a runnable Apache-licensed engine makes the design impossible for maintainers to ignore.

motivation: An expert cache is only viable if the on-disk format lets a runtime fetch one expert instead of a whole layer.
